descriptionInUI: Networks each coalition's SAMs and EWRs into an Integrated Air Defense System, coordinating detection and engagement and letting mobile SAMs shoot-and-scoot instead of fighting as isolated sites. This is a modified build: it carries performance work on the network update loop, and it knows the CurrentHill and Swedish systems that stock Skynet does not. How much of the map it networks is set outside the plugin, under Mission Generator - Performance ("Skynet IADS radius from the action"): 0 is the whole theatre, and anything else leaves the sites far from the fighting to defend themselves.

specificOptions.nameInUI: Radius from the action (km, 0 = whole map)
specificOptions.descriptionInUI: Skynet gets slower the more radars it coordinates, and it is handed every site on the map, for both coalitions. Set a radius and it is handed only what lies within that distance of the front line, a package target or a carrier. The rest are still generated and still fight -- they go to red alert and defend themselves -- they are simply not in the network: they never go dark, never share contacts and never react to a HARM.
